chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him),
it encompasses the antiquity of the Creator and the greatness of His creations, and he concludes it with exhortation.
ai.seo_question: What are the main themes of Imam Ali's sermon regarding God's attributes?
ai.summary: This sermon from Nahj al-Balagha exemplifies the Kufan rhetorical style, blending deep theological reflection on God's eternity (al-Qadam) with the grandeur of creation to establish a foundation for moral exhortation. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on linking metaphysical certainty (yaqeen) with practical ethics, illustrating how divine attributes serve as the basis for human conduct.
